# 00000009790

**OIE-30 △** — source: 311_算子理想与特征值不等式.md

**English.** Definition: K-theory of the Calkin algebra: the index and Fredholm homotopy of the quotient of B(H). Conjecture: The K_1 group of the Calkin algebra is the integers, completely generated by the Fredholm index; the generalized index map is an isomorphism on connected components of the unitary group, with minimal representatives the explicit powers of the shift. (Calkin K1 index isomorphism)

**中文。** 定义：Calkin 代数的 K 理论：B(H) 商的指标与 Fredholm 同伦。猜想：Calkin 代数的 K_1 群为整数且由 Fredholm 指标完全生成；广义指标映射在酉群的连通分支上为同构且分支的极小代表为移位的显式幂。（Calkin K1 指标同构）
